What is Wag! Compare?

Wag! Compare is a free pet insurance comparison service* and we help you compare the top insurance providers to get the best possible deal. Pet insurance FAQs

What is pet insurance?

Pet Insurance helps pet owners by reimbursing them for partial or the total vet bills of the pet’s treatment. Similar to human health insurance, the insured party pays a monthly premium based on the amount of coverage they need.

Learn more about pet insurance terminology.

What does pet insurance cover?

While coverage depends on the plan you choose, pet insurance coverage can range from accident only, to comprehensive accident and illness plans, and may include wellness plan add-ons as well.

Many common pet health conditions and procedures are covered under pet insurance, such as some surgeries, diagnostic tests, and dental work, however some pre-existing conditions are not covered. It is important to understand your coverage limitations when choosing a plan.

Read more details about pet insurance coverage.

How much does pet insurance cost?

There is no one-size fits all when it comes to pet insurance costs. Your monthly premium cost depends on your pet’s physical details and health history, your vet care location and desired coverage. Thus, monthly payments can range anywhere from $10 to $100 per month.

Read more details about pet insurance costs.

If my pet was sick before I got insurance, are they covered?

Some plans do cover pre-existing conditions. It is important to understand what providers will cover your pet’s illness before committing to a pet insurance plan.

Learn more about common pet health conditions that are not covered by pet insurance and if there are exceptions.

Does pet insurance cover elderly pets?

Wag! advises getting pet health insurance when your dog is as young as possible, because some providers have a maximum age limit that they will cover. This can range anywhere from 6 to 12 years old. This is another reason why it is important to compare your options when it comes to pet insurance.

Learn why it is important to get pet insurance when your pet is young. Didn't find the answer? See more FAQs Compare quotes for FREE
